title: Plasma
description: A dark silhouetted figure stands inside a large glass plasma globe emitting vibrant pink, purple and yellow electrical tendrils. A green monstrous hand with black claws extends from the upper right, touching the globe and creating a bright discharge.
prompt: A surreal painting of a dark silhouetted human figure standing inside a large glowing plasma globe with pink, purple and yellow electrical arcs radiating outward. A monstrous green hand with long black claws reaches from the top right corner, touching the globe and sparking electricity. The background is a muted greenish haze with faint yellow smoky patterns and skull-like shapes. Dramatic lighting, painterly style.
